{{Quote|Yavin is one of those gas giants that looks like it missed out on starhood by a very slim margin.|[[Suz Tanwa]]|<ref name="BigRedOne">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040722yavin|text=Yavin: The Big Red One|int=Yavin: The Big Red One}}</ref>}}
'''Yavin Prime''', also known as '''Yavin''' (Yavin pronounced: YAH-vin), was a bright [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] (part of the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]]).

==Description==
[[File:Falcon_approaches_Yavin.png|thumb|left|180px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] approaches Yavin]]
Situated in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]],<ref name="TEA" /> Yavin was a huge, uninhabitable gas giant. Its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was pattered with high-altitude cloud formations, molded by cyclonic storms of 600 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]][[Kilometer per hour/Legends|-per-hour]] winds which boiled gases up from the troposphere. In comparison, the planetary core was a relatively small collection of frozen liquids.<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

The gas giant had numerous [[Moon/Legends|moons]], several of which were [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-sized and three capable of supporting [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] life: These three were<ref name="ANH novel" /> [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], which was the location of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] base prior to its discovery and near destruction in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]; [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]]; and [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]].

Any craft that entered the atmosphere without the benefit of a tracking beacon would quickly become lost, its pilot disoriented by the buffeting winds. It was believed these storms lasted all the way to the surface without letting up. The immense atmospheric pressure was also something to contend with, and could easily crush an unprotected ship. It was for these reasons that Yavin was chosen as the initial location for disposing of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sun Crusher]] superweapon. However, the Sun Crusher's superstrong hull proved resistant to Yavin's dense atmosphere and was quite space-worthy when later recovered by [[Kyp Durron]].

==History==
{{Quote|We are approaching the planet Yavin. The Rebel base is on a moon on the far side. We are preparing to orbit the planet.|An Imperial to Wilhuff Tarkin via intercom|<ref name="ANH" />}}
<div style="float:right">[[File:Death_Star_Yavin.png|thumb|180px|Yavin orbited by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].]]</div>
The [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] was conquered by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] during the reign of their [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], but later abandoned.

After the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Yavin Station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the planet and was used for [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca gem]] "fishing" until it blew apart in [[3956 BBY]] and crashed on [[Yavin 22]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Baron [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] constructed [[Achtnak Turbine Station]], hidden within the gas giant, from which he launched [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] attacks on [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]]; Achtnak was destroyed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] later established [[GemDiver Station]] in the giant's orbit, for the "fishing" of [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca gems]]. GemDiver Station was attacked by the forces of the [[Shadow Academy]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] took Yavin along with the rest of the Yavin system in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] following the [[Invasion of Yavin 4|capture of the Jedi Praxeum]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly states that Yavin Prime is in the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]].
